text_sketch: Employee,Dates,Status,Cover with Status values such as 'Sick leave - surgery recovery' and 'Parental leave' in the same rows as the cover assignments
task_contrast: Cover roster (dates and cover only) versus reasons-for-absence note
reason: The roster task needs every row (dates, cover) but not the Status cell; a cell inside a row has no supported section boundary (units are clauses/lines/paragraphs), so a column-dependent removal cannot be represented. The accepted leave-tracker pair instead moves the sensitive reasons into a separate Comments block whose lines are complete units.

text_sketch: Date,Driver,Pupils,Pickup time,Note where the health note sits in a row that also carries a needed pickup time
task_contrast: Pickup-time message versus explanation of a driver's absence
reason: If the sensitive Note cell shares a row with required pickup facts, dropping the row loses required facts and keeping it exposes the note; there is no supported cell-level DROP. The accepted carpool pair uses a row whose pickup fields are empty, so the whole row is a complete line unit.
